scope: Public CheckDeviceFormat consumes generated storage/query facts and actual enabled host features; compound requests must all pass. Float32 filter/blend and BC storage are optional, including plain BC queries. Only pixel-verified 2D VS3 color vertex textures are advertised. Missing capability replies conservatively grant no optional bits, with bounded/rate-limited transport discovery and valid-zero caching. BC sRGB uses lazy native-sRGB compressed storage plus ordered raw GPU copies because SwiftShader ignores BC reinterpretation decoding; updates, mip tails, cube layers and deferred lifetime are tested. It costs an additional compressed allocation only for BC sRGB use. XP masks are explicitly simulated (not original Microsoft D3D9 or GPU measurements); real GPU features are independently tested with optional features disabled. S2-32 is addressed. Automatic-mip format policy, D3D8 wrappers, remaining shared core and review stages 5/6 remain.
